cat > /tmp/check_vpcs.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash # Array to hold all VPCs and their instance counts declare -A vpc_instances # Get all regions regions=$(aws ec2 describe-regions --query 'Regions[*].RegionName' --output text --region us-east-1) # For each region, get VPCs and instances for region in $regions; do echo "Checking region: $region" >&2 # Get all VPCs in this region vpc_ids=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --query 'Vpcs[*].VpcId' --output text --region "$region" 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$vpc_ids" ]; then continue fi for vpc_id in $vpc_ids; do # Count running instances in this VPC instance_count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \ --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc_id" "Name=instance-state-name,Values=running,pending,stopped" \ --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[*]' \ --output json --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq 'length' | xargs -I {} jq 'reduce .[] as $r ([]; . + $r | length)' <(echo '[]') 2>/dev/null) # Simplified counting instance_count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \ --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc_id" \ --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[*].InstanceId' \ --output json --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq 'flatten | length') echo "$vpc_id|$region|$instance_count" done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_vpcs.sh /tmp/check_vpcs.sh 2>&1 | sort

cat > /tmp/check_all_vpcs.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash regions=$(aws ec2 describe-regions --query 'Regions[*].RegionName' --output text --region us-east-1) for region in $regions; do vpc_count=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --query 'Vpcs' --output json --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq 'length') if [ "$vpc_count" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Region $region has $vpc_count VPC(s)" fi done EOF chmod +x /tmp/check_all_vpcs.sh /tmp/check_all_vpcs.sh

cat > /tmp/final_check.sh << 'EOF' #!/bin/bash echo "=== VPCs WITH NO EC2 INSTANCES ===" echo "" regions=$(aws ec2 describe-regions --query 'Regions[*].RegionName' --output text --region us-east-1) empty_vpcs=() for region in $regions; do vpc_data=$(aws ec2 describe-vpcs --query 'Vpcs[*].[VpcId,IsDefault,Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0]]' --output json --region "$region" 2>/dev/null) if [ -z "$vpc_data" ] || [ "$vpc_data" = "[]" ]; then continue fi echo "$vpc_data" | jq -r '.[] | @csv' | while IFS=',' read -r vpc_id is_default name; do vpc_id=$(echo $vpc_id | tr -d '"') is_default=$(echo $is_default | tr -d '"') name=$(echo $name | tr -d '"') # Get instance count instance_count=$(aws ec2 describe-instances \ --filters "Name=vpc-id,Values=$vpc_id" \ --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[*].InstanceId' \ --output json --region "$region" 2>/dev/null | jq 'flatten | length') if [ "$instance_count" -eq 0 ]; then echo " VPC: $vpc_id" echo " Region: $region" echo " IsDefault: $is_default" echo " Name: $name" echo " Instances: 0" echo "" fi done done EOF chmod +x /tmp/final_check.sh /tmp/final_check.sh
